question:
Simplify the given expression.

(12.43 times 12.43 times 12.43+19.57 times 19.57 times 19.57)/(12.43 times 12.43-12.43 times 19.57+19.57 times 19.57)
solution:
**Given:**

Simplify the expression:

(12.43 × 12.43 × 12.43 + 19.57 × 19.57 × 19.57) / (12.43 × 12.43 - 12.43 × 19.57 + 19.57 × 19.57)

**Formula used:**

Apply the identity: (a³ + b³) / (a² - ab + b²) = a + b

**Calculations:**

Here, a = 12.43 and b = 19.57

Using the identity:

(12.43³ + 19.57³) / (12.43² - 12.43 × 19.57 + 19.57²) = 12.43 + 19.57

= 32

**∴ The simplified value of the expression is 32.**
